# Asking {#asking}

Refunds are asked for in the console:

- open the payment
  and read its state;
- ask for the refund.

<howto id="do_it" @display="Ask for a refund" @lens="user">
Ask the console for a refund in two steps.

<step id="look">
Look at the [window] first.
</step>

<step id="call">
Then call the <ref to="desk"/>.

<warning>A refund can't be undone.</warning>
</step>
</howto>
